description: Shows eSIM plan options as interactive cards. Takes the same trip inputs as search_esim_plans plus the optionIds to show (a subset of its results; the order is always the published ranking).

catalogVersion.description: catalogVersion from the data tool result, so the card can say if prices changed

dataGb.description: Data needed per person in GB; omit to estimate from usage

travellers.description: People travelling; each needs their own eSIM

days.description: Days in this destination (give for every leg, or not at all)

destination.description: Country, territory, city or region, e.g. 'Japan', 'Bali', 'Europe'

usage.description: Phone use if dataGb is unknown: light (~0.3 GB/day), moderate (~0.8), heavy (~2)

name: show_esim_plans
title: Show eSIM plan cards
